DELETE /api/research/attachments/:uid.note: A partner's own proposal attachment: deleted only WHERE uid = ? AND owner_user_id = the caller, so another firm's partner, an admin and the Super Admin get the same 404 a missing one gets; no credentials or a disabled owner get 401.

DELETE /api/research/benchmarks/:uid.note: A member's own research record: read and written only WHERE uid = ? AND owner_user_id = the caller, so every other account (another member, an advisor the document was shared with or whose grant was revoked, an admin, the Super Admin) gets the same 404 a missing record gets, naming nothing and changing nothing; no credentials or a disabled owner get 401.

DELETE /api/research/brief-notes/:uid.note: An advisor's own brief note: deleted only WHERE uid = ? AND owner_user_id = the caller, so the venture's founder, another advisor, an admin and the Super Admin get the same 404 a missing note gets and nothing changes; no credentials or a disabled owner get 401.

AND owner_user_id = the caller, so every other account (another member, an advisor the document was shared with or whose grant was revoked, an admin, the Super Admin) gets the same 404 a missing record gets, naming nothing and changing nothing; no credentials or a disabled owner get 401.

DELETE /api/research/collections/:uid/do.note: The collection is read WHERE owner_user_id = the caller and the membership is removed only for a document WHERE owner_user_id = the caller, so another member's collection, or another member's document under one's own collection, gets the same 404 a missing one gets and removes nothing; no credentials or a disabled owner get 401.

DELETE /api/research/funds/:uid/reports/.note: The report is deleted only WHERE uid, fund_uid and owner_user_id = the caller all match, so another member, another member's report under one's own fund, or one's own report under another member's fund gets the same 404 a missing one gets and deletes nothing; no credentials or a disabled owner get 401.

DELETE /api/research/market-readings/:ui.note: A partner's own market reading: deleted only WHERE uid = ? AND owner_user_id = the caller, so another firm's partner, an admin and the Super Admin get the same 404 a missing reading gets; no credentials or a disabled owner get 401.

GET /api/research/company-directory/:uid.note: A catalogue company record has no owner: the Companies rule (admitsCompanies, D7178) is decided before the record is read, so an investor or partner without a Founder or Advisor licence gets one 403 for an existing and a missing company; an admitted signed-in account reads it; no credentials or a disabled account get 401.

A catalogue company record has no owner: the Companies rule (admitsCompanies, D7178) is checked before the record is read, the record is read through researchCompanyRead (D7819) so an absent, excluded or withdrawn record answers 404 with no facts, and no reviewer is projected.

A catalogue company record has no owner: the Companies rule (admitsCompanies, D7178) is checked before the record is read, the record is read through researchCompanyRead (D7819) so an absent, excluded or withdrawn record answers 404 with no facts, and no reviewer is projected.

GET /api/research/documents/:uid/downloa.note: The document's owner reads it. A share recipient reads it only while the advisor grant the share was made under is live (active and not past expires_at) over a project of the owner; a revoked or expired grant, no grant, or a grant over another founder's project get the same 404 a missing document gets.

GET /api/research/fund-directory/:uid.note: A public fund catalogue record has no owner: every signed-in account reads it (D535), through SERVED_FUNDS; no credentials or a disabled account get 401.

GET /api/research/fund-shortlist/request.note: Every request and dossier read binds the authenticated owner. Another member request id is indistinguishable from an unknown id; sharing a project does not enter this path.

GET /api/research/funds/:uid/reports.note: The fund is read WHERE uid = ? AND owner_user_id = the caller before its reports (themselves owner-bound), so another member's dossier gets the same 404 a missing one gets; no credentials or a disabled owner get 401.

GET /api/research/funds/sheet/callback.note: The OAuth return carries no session: the gate is the state, HMAC-signed, stored, single-use and expiring (consumeSheetsState), naming who started Connect, who must be a Super Admin. No, unsigned, forged, never-issued, expired or spent state, or the state of an admin who is not the Super Admin or of a founder, redirects to the error page with no code exchange and no token stored.

GET /api/research/geographies/:code.note: A catalogue geography page has no owner: every signed-in account reads it (D533); no credentials or a disabled account get 401.

GET /api/research/market-data/countries/.note: Sourced public statistics for one country, not a member's record: every signed-in account reads them (D7318); no credentials or a disabled account get 401.

GET /api/research/market-directory/:slug.note: A catalogue market row has no owner: every signed-in account reads it (D533); no credentials or a disabled account get 401.

GET /api/research/market-readings/:uid.note: A partner's own market reading: read WHERE uid = ? AND owner_user_id = the caller, its attachments owner-bound and its proposals by the caller's own partner_id, so another firm's partner, an admin and the Super Admin get the same 404 a missing reading gets, naming nothing; no credentials or a disabled owner get 401.

GET /api/research/market-readings/:uid/s.note: D7651: the reading is read only WHERE uid = ? AND owner_user_id = the caller, so another member's reading gets the same 404 a missing one does; an investor-only account is refused with 403 before anything is read (D6273 Q2).

GET /api/research/markets/:slug.note: A catalogue market page has no owner: every signed-in account reads it (D533; D7178 offers Markets to accounts Companies refuses); no credentials or a disabled account get 401.

GET /api/research/observations/:id.note: D7716: an observation is a sourced public statistic (provider, source URL, usage note), not a member's record; every signed-in user may read any one, and a request with no sign-in is refused with 401 (tested on all four routes).

GET /api/research/organizations/:uid.note: Research catalogue organizations, not owned records: every signed-in user may read one, through one access decision. Anything derived from a company record is shown only to an account the Companies rule admits (D7178) and only while D7819's served rows serve it; fund links only while SERVED_FUNDS serves the row. An organization the caller may not see answers 404 exactly as a missing one.

GET /api/research/organizations/record/:.note: The organization of a catalogue record: a company record is refused by the Companies rule (D7178) before anything is read, so an account outside it gets one 403 for an existing and a missing record; a fund record follows SERVED_FUNDS and one uid move. An organization the caller may not see answers { organization: null }, the same as none.

GET /api/research/record-identity/:kind/.note: Directory records, not owned ones: a company answers by the Companies rule (D7178) decided before the read, so an account outside it gets one 403 for an existing and a missing record, then D7819's served rows (withdrawn/excluded answer their state only); a fund answers by the fund catalogue's rule (signed in) and SERVED_FUNDS through getFund. A match key, a reviewer and a note are never returned.

GET /api/research/sectors/:slug.note: A catalogue sector page has no owner: every signed-in account reads it; no credentials or a disabled account get 401.
